0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Korille is at her wit's end.

24.original: Express your /doubt to the hardheaded Viis.

25.original: Defeat the Children of the Everlasting Dark.

48.original: I am searching for a friend. She is yea high, sandy colored hair─have you seen her?

49.original: ...No? <sigh> Then I suppose she is off getting herself in trouble.

50.original: She is obsessed with learning all she can of Ronka's history, you see, and has been planning to infiltrate Woven Oath to see the murals there. I told her not to go but she refuses to listen.

51.original: If you were to express your <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>doubt<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> of her schemes, perhaps she can be persuaded to return.

52.original: Please, you have to find her before it is too late.

53.original: I know she means well, but this time she has gone too far.

55.original: Korille sent you to bring me home?

56.original: But I am so close! I cannot─will not─go back!

57.original: The murals may have knowledge that can help my people. Help <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103>. It would be foolish not to try.

58.original: And now is the perfect time. They seem off balance today. As if intruders had already...come... It was you.

59.original: Then you should know better than anyone that my plan will work. If you can draw the attention of even three of their guards, that is all I need.

60.original: If all goes as planned, I will see you back at Fanow.

62.original: She seems preoccupied with something in the distance. Perhaps expressing your <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>doubts<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> about her plan will garner her attention.

63.original: Ah, you are returned. Thank you again for your help at Woven Oath.

64.original: The murals were more beautiful than I dared imagine. And some much older.

65.original: I drew sketches of them that I could continue my studies here. If I should find anything of import, you will be the first to know.

66.original: But before that, I must first go and apologize to Korille.
